h: INEC publishes preliminary voters register online ahead of the 2027 election
p: The Independent National Electoral Commission has put the preliminary voters register online, allowing Nigerians to check their details before the 2027 general election. The commission has said the national register is now above 103 million voters.
more: Voters can check that their names and polling units are correct.
Registration for new voters has run in several phases this year.
